feed_title: Personalised Dog Bed with Embroidered Name, Plush, Fibre Cushioning, Removable Zipped Cover, XS 50 x 45cm to 3XL 145 x 115cm | PawLunova Rydal
descriptionHtml:
Their name stitched in. Plush surface. Seven sizes, XS to 3XL.

Rydal is a personalised plush dog bed with an embroidered name, fibre cushioning and a zipped washable cover, in seven sizes from 50 × 45cm to 145 × 115cm.

Think about who actually reads it. They walk past that bed forty times a day and have never once looked at the front of it. You read it every time you come down the stairs, and so does whoever has come round for a cup of tea.

The name is stitched into the plush rather than printed on top of it, so it goes through the wash with the cover instead of cracking off it.

What they get

  • A name embroidered in, not printed on: Stitching survives the machine. A print cracks and peels.
  • A textured plush surface: Soft where they lie down.
  • Fibre cushioning: Soft comfort rather than firm support. For an older dog who needs support underneath, see our memory foam beds.
  • Seven sizes, 50 × 45cm to 145 × 115cm: Seven steps, from an XS at 50 × 45cm up to a 3XL that measures 145 × 115cm.
  • A zipped cover: It comes off to wash.

Best for: a new puppy, a first Christmas, and anyone buying partly because of how it will look in the hall.

Why it is worth the money

Prices run from £89 for the XS to £299 for the 3XL, and the money is doing something different at each end. At the small end you are buying a gift. At 145 × 115cm you are buying a great deal of bed. Either way the name is embroidered rather than printed, which is why it still reads properly after the tenth wash, when a printed one has gone patchy.

Two things to be straight about. This is fibre cushioning, not foam, so it is soft rather than supportive. And because it carries a name it sits outside the 100-night trial that the rest of our beds carry.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
XS50 × 45
Small65 × 50
Medium75 × 65
Large90 × 80
XL110 × 85
XXL120 × 100
3XL145 × 115

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Getting this right matters more here than on any other bed, because a personalised one cannot be swapped. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label, then air-dry it fully before it goes back on. The embroidery needs no separate treatment.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

Before you order

Personalised beds are made to order with your dog's name, so they are excluded from the 100-night trial and from change-of-mind returns. Check your spelling carefully before you order, because a bed with a name on it cannot be resold. If yours arrives faulty, damaged or not as described, your full legal rights apply. Read the full returns terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Choose their size, check the spelling twice, and have it stitched in.
